figurative_meaning_en: to pretend or put on an act
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আসলে কষ্ট পায়নি, শুধু অ্যাকটিং করছে।
পরীক্ষায় ভালো না করলে অ্যাকটিং করে কাঁদতে শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He's not really hurt; he's just putting on an act.
When she didn't do well on the exam, she started pretending to cry.
note: This idiom is a direct borrowing from English 'acting' and reflects modern urban Bengali influenced by media and cinema.
